answer: Admission runs one lane per canyon: each /24 prefix may mint a single identity per epoch, sealed as a jade pass. A second signup from a used prefix is the trigger: every extra name posts 6,000 POA, burned when review ties the batch to one operator. A hundred clones therefore burn 600,000 POA in bonds plus fifteen dollars monthly for every rented residential link, while honest agents pass their lone canyon once, receipts read under a violet lamp.
